posts.title: Gain-Anchored Tuning for Integrating Processes
posts.description: Overview Gain-Anchored Tuning (GAT) is a PID tuning method for integrating processes, developed by Jacques Smuts of OptiControls. It is particularly suited for level control in large tanks, vessels, and reservoirs with slow process dynamics.
